title: A wrong brand on a product
keys: Each product is keyed as it stood in the catalog of 2026-10-03, before stage A. That state is replayed from the end of stage A (see build/state.mjs).
decidedBy: Plan 0186, target A9, for the products the plan names. An agent found two more. Applied by the directing session, on the word of the owner of 2026-10-06 ("Decide for yourself on the rest, they seem fine").

entries.why: Deza prints "NORDIC Mist" and its brand reader took the first word. El Jamón prints the brand whole: NORDIC MIST. The registry holds `Nordic Mist` with no product. The name follows Schweppes "Tónica original lata".
As above. Only Deza lists this one.

product.nameEs: Snack dental para perro hueso antisarro San Dimas

entries.nameEs: Snack dental para perro hueso antisarro Tasty
entries.nameEn: Tasty anti-tartar dental bone for dogs
entries.why: Deza prints "TASTY San Dimas". The plan moves it to `San Dimas`, which the registry holds with no product. "Tasty" then stays in the name as the range word. Against it: rule 5 of the curation prompt says the brand is the line and not the maker, and Tasty is the line here. The owner approved the plan, so the proposal follows it.
Deza prints "NESTLÉ KitKat" and El Jamón prints KIT KAT as the brand. The catalog holds nine products under `KitKat`. The brand is the line, not the maker.
Not named by the plan. The twin of the row above: Deza prints "Chocolate double chocolate NESTLÉ KitKat", 99 g.
Not named by the plan. El Jamón prints "cereales kit kat" with NESTLÉ as the brand, 190 g. The catalog already holds `KitKat` "Cereales" of 330 g from Deza, so the line is a brand of its own there.

product.nameEs: Queso afinado curado G. Baquero de leche termizada

entries.nameEs: Queso afinado curado de leche termizada
entries.why: The name holds the maker, "G. Baquero". The brand is `La Cava Barus`, which is what Deza prints. Seen beside it: the wedge of the same cheese (3dc5433c, "Queso curado La Cava Barus en cuña", 250 g) stands under `García Baquero` with the line in the name. One line, two brands. Which one is right is the line question of section 1, so only the name is proposed here.

entries.why: The plan moves it to `Gourmet Revelations`. After that move it is the same product as 17a98eca: `Gourmet Revelations` "Comida para gatos mousse con salmón", 228 g (El Jamón prints 4 x 57 g, Deza prints 4x57 g). So the proposal is a merge: accept the Deza row onto 17a98eca and delete 8ac24398. It holds no price, so nothing is lost.

product.nameEs: Mini pizzas jamón y queso ultracongeladas

entries.why: Read against its row: Mercadona prints "Mini pizzas jamón y queso Fiesta ultracongeladas" with the brand Fiesta and the barcode 4009233003976. So the product carries the brand its chain prints. The catalog brand `Fiesta` holds six sweets beside it (Kojak, Lolipop, Fresquito), which are another business with the same name. This is a homonym (plan 0178): a second brand for the frozen food, which only the owner registers. Nothing to rename.
